limits: Preparation unpacks exact complete upstream source and retains every distribution patch/rule, source archive and bundled newlib input. It does not apply a guessed patch subset, run a compiler, promise a bounded full GCC bootstrap, or reproduce a historical archive. The complete distribution build uses its own debian/rules and configured dependencies.
prerequisites: For a full distribution binary rebuild: Ubuntu noble amd64 build environment with the complete Build-Depends/Build-Depends-Indep declared in the retained .dsc; dpkg-dev and distribution build tools.
No network is needed for source preparation. Distribution dependency installation is separate and explicit.
